name: Suspended Color Field
description: The product hangs weightless at the centre of a saturated two-tone color field, rim-lit from both sides in two clearly distinct colors with a fine drift of glowing particulate selling the hover. Its contact shadow dissolves softly into the gradient far below rather than resting on any visible surface, so nothing ever touches or supports it.
lighting: Dual-color rim wrap, one light per field tone
subject: either
prompt: A matte pearl-white ceramic-finish charging case for a pair of wireless earbuds, lid closed and etched with the fine sans-serif wordmark "Halo Audio — Drift," hovering weightless and centered in generous negative space at the heart of a saturated two-tone color field blending from deep violet on one side into molten amber-gold on the other, wrapped in a dual-color rim light with a cool violet glow along one edge and a warm amber-gold glow along the other, the light visibly bending around the case's curved form rather than sitting as a flat colored outline, a fine sparse drift of glowing dust catching both rim colors as it drifts past in shallow focus, a soft contact shadow dissolving gradually into the gradient far below with no wire, strut, or surface ever touching the case, only these two colors appearing anywhere in the field, no second product or prop in frame, immaculate commercial-render clarity.
